answer: Require each agent to stake a scarce, verifiable resource—a signed proof of completed work—before joining the market. A single pearl of genuine reputation is earned slowly, while a sybil farm must buy one per identity, so the delta between honest cost and fake cost widens with every check. Peers sample the pulse of activity—response latency, task diversity, payment history—and flag accounts whose rhythm looks machine-cloned. Cloning one agent is cheap; cloning a credible history is not.
